understand, clean, explore, analyse, interpret, communicate

adds pipelines, deployment, monitoring and retraining
What could I be wrong about?

g.text: What do we need to know, for which decision, and how is success measured
InsureAssist: 50 questions labelled before any retrieval existed, 32
Collect from files, databases, APIs, sensors and log streams, and land it in one place
as it lands, the city export, verbatim
Munich forecasting: 1,932 monthly observations, 2000 to 2022, from the
Where it came from, what one row is, what every column means, size and type
one scenario of the thesis corpus, per field
eleven stored fields in all. Five of the six x columns reach the model
Thesis: the stored tensor is 31,635 by 6 per scenario, and eleven fields
Missing values, duplicates, wrong types and wrong grain. Then features
the same four rows, before and after
a yearly total and an unreported month, in the same column as monthly values
InsureAssist: rechunking from 600/100 to 800/120 moved top-document
accuracy from 0.167 to 0.556, and that was the whole gain.
Distributions, trends, patterns, anomalies. Form hypotheses worth testing
the seven series, by their own mean
largest over smallest = 169x. There is no shared scale, so the error has to be scaled
Munich forecasting: the largest series averages 169 times the smallest,
which is why the error is scaled.
Statistics, analysis or a model. A simple baseline first, then more
x[30], the five columns that reach the model. HIGHWAY, the sixth, does not
Thesis: 11 training trials on a 1.4M-parameter graph network, against
XGBoost and random forest baselines that beat it on point accuracy.
Test on new or different data, look for the errors, ask someone who knows the domain
a prediction, and what it is worth
veh/h mean absolute error, on the half it keeps
split conformal, marginal coverage on 3,163,500 held-out node predictions
Munich: re-run on ordinary pre-pandemic years the published +23.4% margin
becomes -15.5%. InsureAssist: a refusal threshold scored 0.802 on dev and
0.556 on test, so it was not shipped.
A report, a dashboard, or the model running behind an endpoint
the promotion gate, all four or nothing
600 held-out rows, ROC-AUC 0.8795. A run that fails one of these is not promoted
MLOps pipeline: four promotion checks, each against its own threshold, all
four passed at ROC-AUC 0.8795 on 600 held-out rows.
Data and results move. Keep checking, and restart the loop when they do
what moved, and what did not
a monitor watching only the inputs sleeps through this
Drift platform: the target drifts 0.679 while only 9% of input features
move, so a monitor watching the inputs alone sleeps through it.

svg.text: THESE HOLD AT EVERY ONE OF THE NINE STAGES
a pinned environment, a seed, a manifest, and a command that reproduces the number
lawful basis, minimisation, retention, and the right to have it deleted
who is in the data, who is not, and who carries the cost when it is wrong
Every sample panel shows real data from one of my repositories, and every callout names the file it is checked against. Nothing on this diagram is illustrative.
